subject.title: Draft: add commands list and inspect inventory

question: Should OpenClaw publish a separate operator/developer `openclaw commands` inventory and the three new advisory plugin descriptor fields while retaining the existing Gateway `commands.list` model?
rationale: The implementation and proof are credible, but tests cannot decide the permanent public schema, audience boundary, drift ownership, or external plugin compatibility commitment while the linked RFC remains open.

options.title: Approve separate audiences
options.body: Accept distinct CLI and Gateway projections, document their ownership and drift rules, and support the three plugin fields as advisory API.

options.title: Require a canonical model
options.body: Refactor shared command semantics behind one canonical model before publishing audience-specific projections.

options.title: Pause for RFC direction
options.body: Keep the draft open but defer merge preparation until maintainers settle the inventory architecture in the RFC.

recommendation.title: Approve separate audiences
recommendation.body: Accept distinct CLI and Gateway projections, document their ownership and drift rules, and support the three plugin fields as advisory API.

likelyOwner.reason: The central CLI routing, plugin registration, and documentation history points most strongly to this person, and the live discussion routes the public contract decision there.
